claims.claim_quote: روکش موقت در چند هفته لثه را دور خودش شکل داده است.
claims.source_quote:
The gingiva was
molded around the restoration, filling the papillae and resulting
in a broader emergence profile (Figure 7).
claims.note: the time frame is in the preceding sentence of the clinical case: After 3 weeks, the patient was reassessed.

claims.claim_quote: پس اگر فقط از اسکن بادی اسکن بگیریم، لابراتوار لثه‌ی جمع‌شده را می‌بیند و روکش نهایی شکلی را که با روکش موقت ساخته بودیم نخواهد داشت.
claims.note: inference judged on its conclusion (F1). Searched the digital impression section (4), the accurate-transfer section (3.3) and the Conclusions for a statement that a scan-body scan alone loses the soft tissue shape. None found. The source names a scan body only as one of three scans in each Monaco protocol. The collapse and misfit sentences in 3.3 concern conventional stock impression copings, which is a different action and is not gathered (F2-v).

claims.claim_quote: در قالب‌گیری سنتی این مشکل را با ایمپرشن کوپینگ کاستومایز حل می‌کنیم.
claims.source_quote:
After achieving the desirable level of soft
tissue, several techniques are available to achieve a precise transfer of molded gingival architecture, including customized
impression coping, injection of soft material around the provisional restoration in the master cast, and digital impression.
claims.note: naming one of the listed techniques narrows the source finding and does not change it

claims.claim_quote: روکش موقت را روی آنالوگ می‌بندیم و داخل سیلیکون فرو می‌کنیم تا جای بخش ترانس‌موکوزال آن در سیلیکون بماند.
claims.source_quote:
In the indirect technique (Shor et al. 2008; Vasconcellos and
Proussaefs 2016; Velásquez et al. 2015), the provisional restoration is
removed from the mouth and attached to the implant analog.
claims.note: the silicone half also matches the next sentence: A putty silicone index is then made from the gingival part of the restoration.

claims.claim_quote: بعد ایمپرشن کوپینگ را روی همان آنالوگ می‌بندیم و فضای بین کوپینگ و سیلیکون را با رزین آکریلی یا کامپوزیت فلو پر می‌کنیم تا کوپینگ همان فرم ترانس‌موکوزال روکش موقت را بگیرد [۱].
claims.source_quote:
Subsequently, the provisional is detached from
the analog, and the impression coping is attached.
claims.note: the filling half matches the next sentence: The gap between the silicone index and coping is filled with composite or acrylic to replicate the patient's gingival contour. Flowable composite is a subset of composite, so it narrows the finding.

claims.claim_quote: منبع: Atri و Nokar، 2025 (CC BY).
claims.note: figure credit line, asserts nothing

claims.claim_quote: اگر لثه بعد از باز کردن روکش موقت حدود یک دقیقه سر جایش بماند، همان لحظه، در حدود ۱۰ ثانیه، از داخل لثه اسکن می‌گیریم [۱].
claims.source_quote:
The direct method requires stability of peri‐implant tissues
within 1 min after removing the provisional restoration.
claims.note: the 10-second scan half matches the later Three digital impressions are taken sentence: another within 10 s after removing the provisional restoration

claims.claim_quote: این حالت معمولاً وقتی پیش می‌آید که ایمپلنت کم‌عمق است (پلتفرم کمتر از ۴ میلی‌متر زیر لبه‌ی لثه)، لثه ضخیم است و امرجنس پروفایل مخروطی است.
claims.source_quote:
It is
indicated for cases with cone‐shaped emergence profiles and
short, thick peri‐implant soft tissue, where the depth of the
implant platform from peri‐implant soft tissue is less than
4 mm.
claims.note: this situation is read through to the direct-scan case in u27

claims.claim_quote: این عددها معیارهای پروتکل اصلی روش هستند [۱، ۳].
claims.source_quote:
Monaco et al. (2019) introduced direct and
indirect protocols for digital impression‐taking based on emer-
gence profile shape and implant depth.
claims.note: the source itself attributes the criteria to the Monaco protocols

claims.claim_quote: اگر ایمپلنت عمیق است یا لثه زود جمع می‌شود، فرصت اسکن لثه نیست [۱].
claims.source_quote:
The indirect method is indicated when soft tissue stability is
lacking, the emergence profile is cylindrical, and the depth
exceeds 4 mm.
claims.note: the direct method requires both tissue stability and a depth under 4 mm, so failing either one excludes it. The or is consistent with the source.

claims.claim_quote: اینجا روکش موقت را روی آنالوگ می‌بندیم و بیرون از دهان دورتادور اسکن می‌کنیم، از جمله قسمتی که داخل لثه بوده است [۱، ۳].
claims.source_quote:
FIGURE 9 | Digital impression of emergence profile using the indirect method: (a) Scan of the provisional restoration on an implant analog
outside the mouth, (b) Superimposition of the scanned provisional restoration on the oral scan.
claims.note: also stated in the indirect-method protocol sentence in section 4

claims.claim_quote: نرم‌افزار این اسکن را از روی تاج موقت روی اسکن اول جفت می‌کند.
claims.source_quote:
FIGURE 9 | Digital impression of emergence profile using the indirect method: (a) Scan of the provisional restoration on an implant analog
outside the mouth, (b) Superimposition of the scanned provisional restoration on the oral scan.

claims.note: figure credit line, asserts nothing

claims.claim_quote: منبع: Atri و Nokar، 2025 (CC BY).
claims.note: figure credit line, asserts nothing

claims.claim_quote: دقت اسکن ایمپلنت به روش اسکن و عمق ایمپلنت بستگی دارد [۱].
claims.source_quote:
However, the
accuracy of digital impressions may be affected by factors,
such as the impression‐taking protocol and implant depth
(Marques et al. 2021).
claims.note: the source hedges with may be affected. No sentence of the source states this dependence plainly.

source_conclusion: The clinician must select the appropriate technique based on the patient's condition, needs, and available materials and equipment.
fact_fa: از ۱۱ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۱۰ مورد مطابق است، ۱ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا؛ ۱ جمله‌ی دیگر در منبع نیامده است.
interpretation_fa: موارد تغییریافته یا برعکس: «دقت اسکن ایمپلنت به روش اسکن و عمق ایمپلنت بستگی د…» (قاطع‌تر از منبع).

claims.claim_quote: در روش دیجیتال هم ایده همین است: شکل لثه روی خود روکش موقت هست.
claims.source_quote: FDT is a rapid digital approach for achieving all information of the peri-implant soft tissue and emergence profile directly from the provisional retained restoration.
claims.note: comparison with the conventional technique («هم ... همین») is not addressed by the abstract; the stated half (soft tissue shape taken from the provisional) matches

claims.claim_quote: فقط این‌بار به‌جای کپی کردن این شکل روی کوپینگ، از خود روکش موقت اسکن می‌گیریم [۲].
claims.source_quote: This short communication reports on a novel digital technique designated - the "Fully Digital Technique (FDT)" - to take the impression of the peri-implant soft tissue and emergence profile with an intraoral scanner, digitally capturing both the three dimensional position of the implant platform and the coronal and gingival parts of the provisional retained restoration.
claims.note: «فقط» here is a contrastive connective («only that this time»), not an absolute strengthening a finding; the contrast with copying onto a coping is not addressed by the abstract (NOT_ASSESSABLE half)

claims.claim_quote: تاج موقت، لبه‌ی لثه و دندان‌های کناری ثبت می‌شوند.
claims.source_quote: A second digital impression (STL2) with the provisional retained restoration in situ was performed in two steps: the first part of the scan captured all details of the vestibular and palatal sides of the provisional retained restoration and the adjacent teeth.
claims.note: one predicate with a list of objects; capture of the soft tissue margin is consistent with the abstract's peri-implant mucosa in the merged file

claims.claim_quote: نرم‌افزار اسکن‌ها را از روی قسمت‌های مشترکشان، مثل دندان‌های کناری و تاج موقت، روی هم می‌گذارد [۲].
claims.source_quote: STL1 and STL2 were imported into imaging software and superimposed using the "best fit" algorithm to achieve a new merged file (STL3) with the 3D implant position, the peri-implant mucosa, and emergence profile.
claims.note: the abstract states best-fit superimposition but does not name which regions served as the common reference; the named examples are not assessable from the abstract

claims.claim_quote: به این ترتیب قسمت داخل لثه‌ی روکش موقت در جای درستش در فایل قرار می‌گیرد و شکل لثه از روی آن ساخته می‌شود [۲].
claims.source_quote: STL1 and STL2 were imported into imaging software and superimposed using the "best fit" algorithm to achieve a new merged file (STL3) with the 3D implant position, the peri-implant mucosa, and emergence profile.
claims.note: inference judged on its conclusion; the source also states the subgingival part was scanned to determine its subgingival shape and that soft tissue information is taken directly from the provisional

source_conclusion: FDT is a rapid digital approach for achieving all information of the peri-implant soft tissue and emergence profile directly from the provisional retained restoration.
fact_fa: از ۵ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۵ مورد مطابق است، ۰ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا.
interpretation_fa: هر ادعای قابل‌بررسی با منبع مطابق است.

claims.claim_quote: همین که روکش موقت را باز کنیم، لثه شروع به جمع شدن می‌کند [۱، ۳] و اسکن بادی باریک هم جلوی این کلپس را نمی‌گیرد.
claims.source_quote: The indirect technique is used when the gingival tissue collapses rapidly after the removal of the provisional crown.
claims.note: The source reports collapse only for some cases. It names another scenario in which the tissue stays stable ('The direct technique is indicated when the peri-implant soft tissues are stable upon removal of the provisional restoration.'). The unit states collapse as happening every time. The second half (a narrow scan body does not prevent collapse) is NOT_ASSESSABLE: the abstract does not address it, and under F3 it does not decide the verdict.

claims.claim_quote: قسمتی از روکش موقت که داخل لثه قرار دارد (بخش ترانس‌موکوزال) دقیقاً همان شکلی را دارد که لثه گرفته است.
claims.source_quote: The impressions of the provisional restoration and the position of the implant are similar to those obtained with the direct technique, and the shape of the peri-implant tissue is extrapolated from the negative shape obtained from making the digital impression when the provisional restoration is taken out of the mouth.

claims.claim_quote: سه اسکن می‌گیریم و نرم‌افزار آن‌ها را روی هم می‌گذارد [۲، ۳]:
claims.source_quote: Finally, in both techniques the 3 scans are superimposed to obtain a file, which contains the details of the peri-implant soft tissue.
claims.note: The unit ends in a colon but states its own finding (three scans, superimposed), so it is not a signpost. The mention of software is a detail the abstract does not address.

claims.claim_quote: اسکن با روکش موقت در دهان.
claims.source_quote: In the direct technique, an impression (STL1) is made of the provisional restorations attached to the implants, with surrounding gingival tissue.

claims.claim_quote: باز کردن روکش موقت و ثبت شکل داخل لثه، با یکی از دو راهی که پایین آمده است [۱].
claims.source_quote: The second scan (STL2) captures the sulcular aspect of the peri-implant soft tissue immediately after removal of the provisional restoration.

claims.claim_quote: بستن اسکن بادی و اسکن آن، برای ثبت موقعیت ایمپلنت.
claims.source_quote: The last impression (STL3) of the complete arch is made with a standardized scanbody attached to the implant to capture the 3D location of the implant.

source_conclusion: The direct and indirect digital techniques allowed realization of a predictable definitive restoration in the esthetic zone in different clinical scenarios, reducing the duration of clinical procedures.
fact_fa: از ۶ ادعایی که منبع به آن پرداخته‌اند، ۵ مورد مطابق است، ۱ مورد تغییر یافته و ۰ مورد برعکس؛ سطح انطباق بالا.
interpretation_fa: موارد تغییریافته یا برعکس: «همین که روکش موقت را باز کنیم، لثه شروع به جمع شدن…» (دامنه گسترده‌تر از منبع).
